scores.evidence: Both Mermaid diagrams (s1-diagram, s3-diagram) are flowchart TD with short Japanese labels. At 390 px they are readable and nothing is clipped (mobile-jp-04.png, mobile-jp-12/13.png). The 2-column definition tables s1-defs and s3-defs stack cleanly on mobile (mobile-jp-03.png, mobile-jp-12.png). Code blocks s2-skill, s3-file and pr-model show the frontmatter highlights and fit inside the frame (mobile-jp-06.png, mobile-jp-14.png, mobile-jp-23.png).

textOnlyScreens is empty on both desktop-jp and mobile-jp. Every screen has a heading, a figure, a table, code, steps or a question. Desktop JP charsPerLine median is 39, inside the 30–40 target (max 56). The rhythm alternates concept, diagram, code and check with no long walls of text (desktop-jp-03 to desktop-jp-12.png).

All diagram labels, captions, step titles and question options are in Japanese, as the JP-only lesson requires. Terms that need English show it next to the Japanese, for example サブエージェント（subagent） in s3-defs. Inline chips such as disable-model-invocation: true stay whole and readable at 390 px (mobile-jp-10.png, mobile-jp-25.png). No controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars, and contrast is fine throughout.

niceToHave: check-quiz (e1): at 390 px the path chips in options b and a wrap inside their boxes between 'api-' and 'guide/SKILL.md' (pages/mobile-jp-24.png). s2-skill: at 390 px, source line 12 ('1. `git status` と `git diff HEAD` で、') soft-wraps so that 'で、' sits alone on its own row (pages/mobile-jp-06.png). Moving 'で、' to the start of line 13 would avoid the orphaned fragment.

summary: metrics.json has no hard failures: no horizontal overflow, 0 console, Mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors, and no text-only screens. Desktop JP line length is on target (median 39). Both diagrams, the definition tables and the SKILL.md code blocks are readable at 390 px and 1440 px. The screens show no personal data. There are no must-fix items. The only small issues are the wrapped api-guide path chips in exam question e1 on mobile and an orphaned 'で、' on a wrapped code line in s2-skill.
